keyEvents.text: Goal! Lazio 1, AC Milan 0. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Adam Marusic.
Second Half begins Lazio 1, AC Milan 0.
Pervis Estupiñán (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, AC Milan. Davide Bartesaghi replaces Pervis Estupiñán.
Substitution, AC Milan. Zachary Athekame replaces Fikayo Tomori.
Substitution, AC Milan. Niclas Füllkrug replaces Rafael Leão.
Substitution, Lazio. Boulaye Dia replaces Daniel Maldini.
Substitution, AC Milan. Christopher Nkunku replaces Youssouf Fofana.
